mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates a severe labor market downturn that triggers corporate cost-cutting and reduced hiring, leading to lower earnings growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE exceeds 9.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which signals reduced corporate revenue growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1% from the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply-driven expansion (indicated by rising industrial production), manufacturing output growth accelerates, boosting corporate profits and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 550,000 units, it signals a contraction in the residential construction sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when HOUST falls below 550,000 units, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery phase (indicated by a declining unemployment rate), job growth accelerates, increasing consumer spending and corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines by at least 0.2 percentage points month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past three months indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a coordinated monetary and labor market stimulus that boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE decline by at least 0.10 percentage points, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
